artworks.title: Diana
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a woman depicted from the waist up. She is slightly hunched forward and looking downward. Her facial features are delicately rendered, and her curly hair is styled away from her face with a headband. She wears a band or bracelet on her upper arm and appears to be draped in a cloth that partially covers her lower body. The setting around her is artistically rendered with engraved patterns suggesting texture and depth, with lightly sketched clouds on the left side.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew the Evangelist
artworks.medium: color etching with roulette inked à la poupée on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of an elderly man holding a pen in his right hand and a scroll in his left hand. He has a prominent nose, full beard, and curly hair. He is dressed in a robe with a purple outer layer, a blue inner layer, and an orange cloak draped over one shoulder. Next to him is the head of a cherub with curly hair. Large wings are visible under the figures. The background is plain, and the image is framed with text at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Praying Monk
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling, with their back towards the viewer. They are covered by a hooded cloak that obscures their body and face. A cross is visible rising from the cloak's hood. No other facial features or hair are visible. There is a wooden structure in front of them that resembles an altar or a bench. The person's form casts a shadow, and the cloak and wooden surface have textured lines. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Bacchus with Dancing Nymphs
artworks.description: This drawing shows multiple figures engaging in a dance scene. Three figures are at the center forming a circle and raising their arms together. Some figures are holding objects like a branch with leaves and grapes. Others are depicted in various celebratory activities. One figure is sitting on a large barrel. The detailed line work and shading convey a sense of movement and camaraderie. The scene includes elements like musical instruments and wine vessels on the ground.

artworks.title: Allegory of Water
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on pink prepared laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 16.2 x 12.9 cm (6 3/8 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a ship on their shoulders in a detailed landscape. The central figure is standing on rocky terrain with a sailing ship on their shoulder. Behind them, there is a turbulent sky with dark clouds. In the background, there are several draped figures on a rocky outcrop. The foreground has calm water with aquatic creatures, and there is intricate detailing of flora and mythical elements. The drawing style uses strong lines and shading to create depth and movement.

artworks.title: The Satyr's Family
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures and a goat in a pastoral scene. The artwork shows a woman sitting on the ground, wrapped in a cloth, milking a goat into a pot. Another figure leans against a wooden fence, holding grapes, while two small figures are playing or resting nearby. The setting is outdoors with foliage and a full moon in the background. The drawing has intricate detailing and cross-hatching for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Entführung (Abduction)
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays two male figures wrestling. One figure is behind the other, with their arms reaching around. The man in front is lifting his opponent, with a strong stance and legs apart. The man in front has his back to the viewer, while the man behind has partially visible facial features and dark hair. Both figures are nude, showcasing their muscular bodies. The background is dark and textured, hinting at a natural setting. A signature is barely visible in the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on two sheets of card stock
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows a headshot and a section of the upper body of a person drawn in black ink on tan paper. The person is portrayed in a three-quarter view with their head slightly tilted to one side. Their facial features include slanted, closed eyes and a large mustache curling at the ends. The person wears a tall top hat, a high-collared garment, and a tie. The background is plain. The number "1909" is written vertically along the right edge of the image.

artworks.title: Apollo
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure standing in a powerful pose with one foot resting on clouds. His head is turned slightly to the side, exhibiting strong facial features with prominent cheekbones and a serious expression. His hair is flowing upwards. The figure is unclothed, revealing a muscular physique, apart from a cape billowing around him. He is holding a long arrow-like object in one raised hand, while the other hand holds part of the cape. The background is filled with swirling clouds and beams of light, and there is an inscription in a circular pattern emanating from his head. In the distance, there is a chariot with horses and figures. The entire image is enclosed in an oval frame.

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid
artworks.description: The image depicts a classical-style engraving with a woman and a cherub. The woman is reclining on a drapery, her head tilted to one side, and a serene expression on her face. The cherub is next to her, with small wings. Both figures are partially covered by flowing fabric. The woman holds two long arrows. Surrounding them are etched items like a rose and artichokes. In the background are swirling clouds, a chariot, and smaller figures in a landscape. The engraving is framed with an ornate border and Latin text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Juno
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 33.8 x 25.3 cm (13 5/16 x 9 15/16 in.) (trimmed within plate mark)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a seated woman with elaborate styling. She is positioned slightly turned to her right, wearing a flowing garment and holding a scepter. She is adorned with a beaded necklace and bracelets, and there is a peacock beside her. The surrounding frame contains intricate designs of coins, a large urn, and luxurious items. In the background, there is a sky scene with a chariot and horses, clouds swirling around, and a pastoral landscape with small figures and cattle on the ground below.

artworks.title: Walchensee mit Jochberg (Walchensee with Jochberg)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a landscape with a horizon line in the middle of the composition. Mountainous forms meet the sky, and there are hills and mountain ridges beyond a water body. The etching uses a brushstroke technique with short, scratchy lines for texture and detail. The color palette is limited to black ink on a light tan background, creating contrast and emphasizing linear elements and textures in the landscape. Vegetation details are depicted with dense crosshatchings, while distant mountains appear softer and more abstracted.

artworks.title: Bäume mit Sonne (Trees in the Sun)
artworks.description: The image displays a wooded area seen from a straight-on perspective, with a cluster of trees. The horizon is low in the composition, with the ground layer faintly suggested. The artwork shows expressive brushstrokes creating movement and texture through varying intensities of black lines and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, with black dominating an off-white background, emphasizing the interplay of lines and negative space. A large tree is positioned slightly to the left, with additional trees extending beyond.

artworks.title: From the Jewish Quarter in Amsterdam: Fishmarket on the Street Corner
artworks.medium: etching on heavy wove cream paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor market scene. The image shows a group of figures gathered around tables holding goods for sale. The drawing is executed with sketch-like lines creating a sense of movement and activity. The background indicates a busy market atmosphere with more individuals in the densely packed area. The use of shading and line work suggests depth and the crowded nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image depicts an older male figure with deep facial lines and shadows. He has sparse, short hair and a receded hairline, and is dressed in semi-formal attire with a jacket, collar, and tie visible. The sketch uses bold, impressionistic lines typical of charcoal or pencil on a plain, light background.

artworks.title: Heroic Landscape with Fisherman, Cows, and Horsemen
artworks.artist: John Baptist Jackson after Marco Ricci
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in color on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene from an elevated viewpoint. There are large columns of a classical ruin and a leafy tree on the left. On the right, there is a spreading tree with intricate leaves. In the background, there is a pastoral landscape with figures and animals. A shepherd and a cow are guiding a flock of sheep, and buildings can be seen in the distance. The horizon divides the image into sky and earth. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing textures effectively. The color palette consists of earthy tones with touches of brighter colors on the figures' clothing.

artworks.title: Allegorical Female Figure
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image displays a drawing of a female figure standing in a graceful pose. She has curly hair, facial features, and is holding a thin stick. She is dressed in a flowing garment resembling a Greco-Roman style. The background is plain, and there is a red stamped seal in the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: A Starling and a Lark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows two birds on their backs. One bird has glossy black feathers with iridescent highlights, while the other is tawny with white and brown spotted undersides. The color palette includes earthy browns, tawny yellows, and hints of iridescent greens and blues. The larger tawny bird is slightly on top and to the right of the darker bird, which is to the left. In the background, there is subtle imagery of grass and foliage in muted natural tones on a brown background.

artworks.title: Sweet Peas
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image features several sweet pea flowers drawn with intricate details. The petals of the flowers are light and feathery. The color scheme is monochromatic using shades of black and gray against a light background, emphasizing the contrast between the flowers and the background. The flowers are arranged in the center with their stems and petals extending outward. The top and bottom edges of the image have sparse areas, directing focus towards the central floral composition.

artworks.title: My Poor Sweet Little Angelica
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image features a baby lying on a cushioned surface. The baby is on its back with its head turned slightly to the side. The facial features are gentle, with wide eyes, a small nose, and an open mouth. The baby's hair is sparse. The baby is wrapped in a light fabric, likely a blanket or garment, covering the lower body. The shoulders and arms are exposed. The baby rests on soft bedding or a cushion. There is no jewelry or objects in the baby's hands. The background is a plain, light-colored surface, with some age-related marks. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten note with words such as "little angel" and a poetic line. The focus is on the delicate depiction of the infant.

artworks.title: Minerva
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 33.9 x 25 cm (13 3/8 x 9 13/16 in.) (trimmed within plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a female figure seated on clouds. The central figure wears a helmet with plumes and flowing robes. She holds a spear and rests her hand on a shield with a frightening face. An owl sits beside her. Surrounding elements include spears and helmets. Two smaller scenes in the background depict a chariot and a group of figures. The drawing style is detailed and dynamic, with ornate borders and weapon illustrations.

artworks.title: Head of a Faun
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after François Boucher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait capturing the side profile of a figure's head and a partial view of the upper shoulder. The figure faces to the left and appears to be slightly leaning forward. The figure has a prominent, elongated nose, a full beard, wild, naturally styled hair with a wreath made of leaves and grapes, and small, curved horns on the forehead. The clothing is nondescript, suggesting a single garment draped over the shoulder. The background is crosshatched, creating a textured effect. There are no additional objects in the background, maintaining focus on the figure's profile.

artworks.title: Ephraim Bonus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 34 x 26.2 cm (13 3/8 x 10 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a seated man. The man is positioned facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. He has curly hair that reaches his collar, a full beard and mustache, deeply set eyes, and a slightly downturned mouth. The man is dressed in a dark robe with a row of buttons running down the center and a white collar. He is wearing a cap on his head. His right hand rests on a large hat on his knee. Behind him, there is an elaborately crafted chair back with a lion's head carving, and in the background, there is a partially visible column.

artworks.title: An Imaginary Prison
artworks.description: This drawing shows an architectural interior with arches and staircases. The composition highlights a complex structure with vaulted arches, heavy stonework, and intersecting stairways. Large vertical structures create grandeur, while cross-hatching and shading emphasize the stone and beams' texture. The drawing evokes mystery and complexity, with light and shadow adding to the dramatic atmosphere.
